turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. 

Um... well, I hope I'm explaining this right, and I really don't want to sound, you know, crazy or anything. I'm sure it's probably just stress from work, but... I've been having a little trouble at the shop. I'm a mechanic, and lately, I keep hearing this... this man's voice. 

It comes from the garage vents, and sometimes even from under the hood when I'm working on a vehicle. It's just as clear as if somebody were standing right next to me. And, um, he keeps telling me not to trust my husband, or he tells me that I shouldn't touch certain cars. I thought it was probably best to come in and talk to someone about it. Is that... does that make sense why I'm here? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing.
